textures: quad mesh primitives and texture mapping for grids

Source: R/textures-package.R
textures-package.Rd

A quad mesh on a regular grid is completely determined by a tiny recipe: the grid dimension, its extent, and the y orientation. textures provides that recipe at four levels of materialization: the recipe itself (quad_spec()), the unexpanded cell edge coordinates (quad_edges()), the materialized index and vertices (quad_index(), quad_vertex()), and assembled 'mesh3d' objects (quad_mesh(), quad(), quad_texture()).

Details

Texture mapping is the motivating use: an image draped over a mesh is resampled by the graphics engine, not by the data pipeline, so mesh density is independent of image resolution and coordinate transformation is a vertex operation only. Transformation itself belongs outside this package - the vertex matrix is the interchange.
